# WeatherXM Documentation

> Technical documentation for WeatherXM weather stations, Web & Mobile Apps, deployment, QoD v3 data quality, Reward Mechanism v2.0, WeatherXM Pro, and weather science.

## Canonical resources
- Main WeatherXM site: https://weatherxm.com/
- WeatherXM Web App (Station Cockpit): https://app.weatherxm.com/
- WeatherXM Explorer: https://explorer.weatherxm.com/
- WeatherXM Pro & API: https://pro.weatherxm.com/
- FACT (Forecast Accuracy Comparison): https://fact.weatherxm.com/
- Claim Rewards dApp: https://claim.weatherxm.com/
- Weather station catalog: https://weatherxm.com/stations/
- Data & forecasts: https://weatherxm.com/data/
- Open technology: https://weatherxm.com/open/
- Firmware flasher: https://flasher.weatherxm.com/
- Network Association: https://weatherxm.network/
- GitHub: https://github.com/WeatherXM
